diagnosis.llm_reason: The physician discharge diagnosis is desmoid tumor (aggressive fibromatosis, a locally aggressive soft-tissue fibroblastic neoplasm of uncertain behavior). No rank in the differential names a neoplasm or soft-tissue tumor. Rank 1 'Post-procedural pain' is a symptom/postoperative complication, not the tumor itself; ranks 2-5 (hepatitis C, hypokalemia, hypocalcemia, anemia) are unrelated infectious, electrolyte, and hematologic conditions. No same-principal condition is present at any rank.
